title: Status & Findings section added to project page
body: Living journal powered by /page Telegram command. Entries stored in status.json, rendered as Apple-minimalist timeline. Tags: status, finding, milestone.

title: GitHub Pages site launched
body: Research portfolio live at fr0do.github.io. Ouroboros project page with auto-updating vitals via /page Telegram command. Apple-minimalist design, zero dependencies.

title: Issue journaling workflow established
body: Every feature now starts as a GitHub issue with self-discussion in comments. /feature Telegram command creates structured issues. /vitals dashboard shows project health as a 2x2 chart.

title: Multi-agent orchestration integrated
body: Native Claude Code agent teams (3-5 teammates, shared task list, plan approval gates) replaced the filesystem-based team/ fallback. Parallel agent implementation with zero file conflicts.

title: CI/CD pipeline: ruff, stale bot, release automation
body: Pre-commit with ruff linting on push. Stale issue bot (90d stale, 30d close). Release workflow on tag push. Upstream sync from razzant/ouroboros daily.

title: Telegram bot: 17 commands operational
body: Full remote control panel: /run, /stop, /logs, /metrics, /completions, /ckpt, /disk, /sync, /gpu, /crashlog, /vitals, /feature, /page, /team, /note, /task, /update. Runs on kurkin-1 compute node.

title: RTK token savings: 60-90% on CLI operations
body: Rust Token Killer auto-proxies all shell commands via Claude Code hook. Massive context window savings on git, file listing, and dev operations.

title: Spectral-R1: curriculum GRPO training in progress
body: LFM2.5-1.2B-Thinking with spectral energy rewards. Dataset v3 (adjacency lists, 3-6 nodes, forced 2+ hops). Strong conciseness rewards shaping reasoning length.

title: Ouroboros bootstrapped
body: Initial meta-project created via Cowork. OUROBOROS.md governance protocol, Telegram bot skeleton, project registry for s_cot, long-vqa, bbbo.
